dct_title_s: Mali Subnational Population and Housing Data Tables with Administrative Boundaries, Based on National Census and Surveys
dct_description_sm: The geodatabase contains boundaries for the national and first-, second-, and third-order administrative divisions, aligned to the Large Scale International Boundaries dataset from the U.S. Department of State. The feature classes are suitable for linking to the attribute data provided. The tabular data contain total population for 2018 (population projections), as well as information relating to IDP movements, nationality, migration, language, economy, households, households, building materials, and amenities.
